title.es: Plan de bienvenida para nuevos vecinos
title.en: A Welcome Plan for New Neighbours

intro.es: Practica lectura de inglés A2 con un texto original sobre community welcome.
intro.en: Practise A2 English reading with an original text about community welcome.

mission.es: Identifica la idea global, comprueba la evidencia y reconstruye la secuencia.
mission.en: Identify the main idea, check evidence, and reconstruct the sequence.

content.targetText: Hello everyone, two families will move into Maple Court next month. The residents’ group would like to welcome them without making the first week too busy. On Saturday 3 June, we will leave a small basket at each door with local information, tea, and a map. In the afternoon, volunteers can show the families the recycling room, the bus stop, and the shared garden. Please do not visit their flats unless they invite you. If you can help, reply with one hour when you are free. The group also asks everyone to keep the two visitor parking spaces free during that weekend, so the removal vans have room to unload. Anyone with spare boxes or garden pots can leave them, clearly labelled, in the hall. We will make a rota and send it on Monday.
content.plainTextForAnalysis: Hello everyone, two families will move into Maple Court next month. The residents’ group would like to welcome them without making the first week too busy. On Saturday 3 June, we will leave a small basket at each door with local information, tea, and a map. In the afternoon, volunteers can show the families the recycling room, the bus stop, and the shared garden. Please do not visit their flats unless they invite you. If you can help, reply with one hour when you are free. The group also asks everyone to keep the two visitor parking spaces free during that weekend, so the removal vans have room to unload. Anyone with spare boxes or garden pots can leave them, clearly labelled, in the hall. We will make a rota and send it on Monday.
